core_obligations: Show D = D_1 + D_2 is a relative effective Cartier divisor with the right finiteness properties
Upgrade to finite locally free via separatedness and properness of the sum
Compute the degree on fibres via local equations

proof_roadmap.step: Show D = D_1 + D_2 is a relative effective Cartier divisor with the right finiteness properties
Upgrade to finite locally free via separatedness and properness of the sum
Compute the degree on fibres via local equations

difficulty_reason: Prove D_1 + D_2 is finite locally free of degree d_1 + d_2 for relative effective divisors on a smooth relative curve: each D_i is a relative effective Cartier divisor (lemma-divisors-on-curves), so D = D_1 + D_2 is one too (divisors-lemma-sum-relative-effective-Cartier-divisor), making D -> S locally quasi-finite, flat, lfp; the surjective integral morphism D_1 amalg D_2 -> D gives separatedness and then properness (morphisms-lemma-image-universally-closed-separated, morphisms-lemma-image-proper-is-proper), finiteness (more-morphisms-lemma-characterize-finite) and finite locally free (morphisms-lemma-finite-flat); for the degree, base change to a fibre, support the divisors at finitely many closed points with nonzerodivisors f_{i,1}, f_{i,2}, write D = coprod Spec(O_{X,x_i}/(f_{i,1}f_{i,2})) and read off the additive degree (algebra-lemma-ord-additive if needed).
